svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bought base kit, 94 mm across, 25 mm tall. Drill six holes right through it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: All six sit on one 60 mm circle round the centre, between the blades:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: dome screws at 60, 180 and 300 degrees; stack screws at 0, 120 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 240 degrees, anticlockwise from the street side seen from above.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The base drilling layout picture shows them from below.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 3.4 mm through, with a scrap block under the top face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Countersink each hole from below, 6 mm across, so the screw heads sit

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flush inside the gasket ring and clear of the contact wells.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Keep the gasket ring (35 to 45 mm radius underneath) untouched.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Crimp a 150 mm lead on each blade (1.0 mm2) and each low-voltage

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: contact (0.25 mm2) before anything is fitted on top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no hole breaks into a blade pocket or the gasket ring.
